title: Section 6: TailnetCertVerifier accept-any rationale is sound
description: discovery.rs:56-65 TailnetCertVerifier accepts any certificate from a tailnet IP. This is the correct design for Tailscale: identity is proven at the WireGuard network layer; the TLS cert provides transport confidentiality only. A future contributor might suggest 'we should pin the cert' or 'we should validate the SAN' — those would be wrong for kithd's threat model. The cert identity is irrelevant; Tailscale proves the IP belongs to the right node. This design should be defended if challenged.
